description:
Title: DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen

A nifty online tool helps you with repairing your Smartphone on your own.
You start by entering the model and what is broken.
The tool gives you the list of materials, the list of tools, and (for each part) several ordering choices.
Some stuff you already have (e.g. some tools, screws).
The tool also lets you contact friends if you can borrow / buy something for cheap from them.
The rest you buy.
Afterwards you receive instructions how to fix your phone.
If it worked, send a review and/or video of you fixing it.
If it hasn't worked out, you can send it to an expert.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_DIYPhoneRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/diy-smartphone-repair"
                  exporter="BPMN Modeler" exporterVersion="1.0">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Defect" name="Model and defect"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_List" name="Material and tool list"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Review and/or video"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Expert" name="Broken phone for expert repair"/>

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Tool" name="Online Repair Tool" processRef="Process_Tool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friend" name="Friend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Expert Repair Service"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DefectToTool" name="Model and defect" sourceRef="SendTask_SendDefect" targetRef="StartEvent_Defect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ListToCustomer" name="Material and tool list" sourceRef="SendTask_SendList" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_ListReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequestToFriend" name="Borrow or buy request" sourceRef="SendTask_ContactFriend" targetRef="Participant_Friend"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ResponseFromFriend" name="Friend response" sourceRef="Participant_Friend" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_FriendResponse"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VideoToTool" name="Video" sourceRef="SendTask_SendVideo" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PhoneToExpert" name="Broken phone" sourceRef="SendTask_ToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer DIY Repair" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterDefect" name="Enter phone model and defect"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendDefect" name="Send model and defect" messageRef="Msg_Defect"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_ListReceived" name="Material and tool list received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ListReceived" messageRef="Msg_List"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectOptions" name="Select ordering options per part"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Owned" name="Item already owned?" default="Flow_NotOwned"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Friend" name="Friend can lend or sell cheaply?" default="Flow_Buy"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ContactFriend" name="Contact friend" messageRef="Msg_FriendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_FriendResponse" name="Friend response received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FriendResponse" messageRef="Msg_FriendResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Buy" name="Buy remaining item"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge" name="Items ready"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Instructions" name="Repair instructions received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Instructions" messageRef="Msg_Instructions"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_Repair" name="Repair phone following instructions"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Send review and/or video?" default="Flow_NoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendReview" name="Send review" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendVideo" name="Send video of repair" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Join" name="Feedback handled"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ToExpert" name="Send phone to expert" messageRef="Msg_Expert"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Repair completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SentToExpert" name="Phone sent to expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="UserTask_EnterDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterDefect" targetRef="SendTask_SendDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendDefect" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_ListReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_ListReceived" targetRef="UserTask_SelectOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectOptions" targetRef="Gateway_Owned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owned" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Owned" targetRef="Gateway_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemOwned == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOwned" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Owned" targetRef="Gateway_Friend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Friend" targetRef="SendTask_ContactFriend">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${friendCanProvideCheaply == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buy" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Friend" targetRef="Task_Buy"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="SendTask_ContactFriend" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_FriendResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_FriendResponse" targetRef="Gateway_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Task_Buy" targetRef="Gateway_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Instructions" targetRef="ManualTask_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="ManualTask_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_Success"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairOk" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Success" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFailed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Success" targetRef="SendTask_ToExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review" name="Review sent" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="SendTask_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reviewSent == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video" name="Video sent" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="SendTask_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${videoSent == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="SendTask_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" sourceRef="SendTask_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="SendTask_ToExpert" targetRef="EndEvent_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Tool" name="Online Repair Tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Defect" name="Model and defect received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Defect" messageRef="Msg_Defect"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_Determine" name="Determine required materials and tools"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_Options" name="Provide ordering options per part"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendList" name="Send material and tool list" messageRef="Msg_List"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareInstr" name="Prepare repair instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendInstr" name="Send repair instructions" messageRef="Msg_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Feedback" name="Receive review or video" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Feedback" name="Feedback recorded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Defect" targetRef="ServiceTask_Determine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T2" sourceRef="ServiceTask_Determine" targetRef="ServiceTask_Options"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T3" sourceRef="ServiceTask_Options" targetRef="SendTask_SendList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendList" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareInstr"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T5" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareInstr" targetRef="SendTask_SendInstr"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T6" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInstr" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T7" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback" targetRef="EndEvent_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
